senses: to enquire of, consult (of deity, oracle)
(Niphal) to ask for oneself, ask leave of absence
to grant, make over to, let (one) ask (successfully) or give or lend on request (then) grant or make over to

strongs.def: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand
strongs.kjv: ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, [idiom] earnestly, enquire, [phrase] greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, [phrase] salute, [idiom] straitly, [idiom] surely, wish
